messages:
Priya: Quick scheduling ask — our candidate (Ravi K) for Sr Infra interview is booked 2024-08-01 10:00 PT but the panel includes EMEA folks. Can we confirm conversions and whether we should move to 16:00 CET instead? Also need a debrief owner and someone to cover code review for the take-home.

Elena: I can take debrief ownership if the time works. 10:00 PT = 19:00 CET right? that might be late for some.

Samir: Quick calc: `10:00 PT = 18:00 BST / 19:00 CEST` depending on DST. If candidate is flexible, +1h later is ok for me.

Maya: I'm in APAC that day, can't do later than 10:00 PT. Can we swap in Jordan (has overlap)? @Jordan are you free 10am PT?

Jordan: I can do 10am PT. Happy to swap in. I'll also take the code-review slot after the interview — want a quick look at the take-home.

Priya: Thanks — @Jordan that's perfect. For the take-home, candidate repo: https://github.com/ravi-k/infra-takehome — can you leave inline comments? Prefer a quick pass by EOW.

Samir: Will do code review pass tomorrow. Quick ask: rubric weighting — keep system design 40% or bump to 50% given role?

Elena: Let's keep design 40, implementation 30, communication 20, culture 10 per guide. If we want to emphasize infra scaling, add a note in the debrief doc.

OpsBot: Calendar event updated: Panel -> 'Ravi K — Sr Infra' 2024-08-01 10:00 PT, attendees: Priya, Jordan, Samir, Maya, Elena.

Priya: Scribe? @Aisha can you capture notes and collect scores?

Aisha: Yep, I'll scribe and collect ratings. Will post debrief doc template link later.

Maya: Thx. If anything shifts ping here. :thumbsup:

Priya: Final ask — Jordan, can you add a 30-min code review block after the interview on the calendar? If not, I'll reserve.

Jordan: Added 30m at 11:00 PT. I'll post review notes in thread.
